Demonstrate smallest-ever spacecraft with full 3-axis attitude determination and control.
Description

Demonstrate smallest-ever spacecraft with full 3-axis attitude determination and control. Design, build, and launch a a 50mm3 spacecraft to demonstrate the capability of 3-axis attitude determination and control. The spacecraft will be equipped with a camera, and LoRa radios for communication and ranging.
